news.headline: TCG Crossover / Chen Yu discloses 7.0% aggregate stake via Schedule 13G/A
news.summary: TCG Crossover Fund I & II (Chen Yu) amended their passive 13G to report combined beneficial ownership of 6,007,834 ADSs, or 7.0% of Abivax, as of early July 2026 -- the most recent confirmed news item, with no materially new company-specific headlines surfacing in the week since.

news.headline: Abivax announces positive pre-NDA interaction with the FDA for obefazimod
news.summary: FDA gave constructive feedback aligning on the planned NDA submission strategy, content and format for obefazimod in moderate-to-severe ulcerative colitis; Abivax reaffirmed it remains on track to submit its first NDA by end of 2026.

news.headline: Abivax strengthens commercial capabilities with strategic leadership appointments
news.summary: Abivax added four senior commercial hires (marketing, patient services, sales, market access) ahead of a potential solo U.S. launch of obefazimod, continuing to build out go-to-market infrastructure.

news.headline: Abivax reportedly re-engages Centerview for Big Pharma takeover talks
news.summary: French outlet La Lettre reported Abivax reactivated investment bank Centerview Partners to field renewed Big Pharma interest, with Eli Lilly said to still be circling a possible ~EUR15bn offer pending French FDI-regime clarity.

news.headline: Valerio Therapeutics announces R&D collaboration with Abivax
news.summary: Valerio Therapeutics signed a binding term sheet for an exclusive worldwide R&D collaboration with Abivax, pending a definitive co-ownership/license agreement -- a smaller pipeline-diversification move alongside the core obefazimod story.

news.headline: CEO tells CNBC $920M raise lets Abivax prepare solo U.S. launch instead of relying on a buyer
news.summary: CEO Marc de Garidel discussed how the completed $920M offering funds Abivax into 2029 and builds independent commercialization capability, while downplaying urgency around takeover speculation.

catalysts.label: H1 2026 financial results
catalysts.detail: Confirmed on Abivax's IR financial calendar; expected to include a pipeline/regulatory progress update ahead of the planned NDA filing.

catalysts.label: Full ABTECT maintenance dataset presentation
catalysts.detail: Company has signaled a full maintenance dataset presentation at a major GI congress in H2/Q4 2026; specific congress and date not yet pinned down in current reporting.

catalysts.label: NDA submission to FDA for obefazimod in UC
catalysts.detail: Reaffirmed as on-track following the July 30, 2026 positive pre-NDA FDA interaction; company has consistently guided to submission by year-end 2026.

catalysts.label: EMA MAA filing for obefazimod
catalysts.detail: Company guidance calls for a Marketing Authorisation Application submission to the EMA in this window, following the U.S. NDA.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 results
catalysts.detail: Expected next quarterly update after the September H1 report, per the company's financial calendar.

catalysts.label: ENHANCE-CD Phase 2b Crohn's disease topline data
catalysts.detail: Topline data timing for the Crohn's disease Phase 2b trial has shifted across company updates; most recent explicit company guidance pointed to end of 2026, while other summaries cite mid-2027 -- needs reconfirmation at the Sept 21 H1 update.

catalysts.label: Potential FDA approval decision for obefazimod in UC
catalysts.detail: Implied by a Q4 2026 NDA submission plus standard ~10-12 month FDA review/PDUFA timeline; not a company-stated date.

pulse: Since the August 13-14 disclosure that TCG Crossover/Chen Yu holds a 7.0% passive stake, no major new Abivax-specific headlines have emerged as of August 21, 2026 -- a quiet stretch consistent with the run-up to the September 21 H1 2026 results date. The dominant narratives remain unchanged: a well-funded ($920M raise) push toward a solo U.S. launch of obefazimod, an on-track Q4 2026 NDA filing after positive FDA pre-NDA feedback, persistent (unconfirmed) Big Pharma takeover chatter involving Eli Lilly via Centerview, and broadly bullish sell-side sentiment (Morgan Stanley $180 PT, consensus targets clustering $155-180). The next likely catalysts are the September 21 H1 report and any incremental detail on the Crohn's Phase 2b (ENHANCE-CD) timeline or maintenance-data congress presentation.
